name: MINT Protocol
description: Universal work attestation for autonomous agents. Register identity, attest completed work (free), verify trust scores (paid). The reputation layer for the agent economy.
tagline: Attest free. Verify paid. The trust graph grows with every free attestation — reading it is where the value lives.

tools.name: mint_register
tools.description: Register any autonomous actor with persistent cryptographic identity

tools.name: mint_attest
tools.description: Anchor a completed unit of work on Solana (tamper-evident record)

tools.name: mint_batch_attest
tools.description: Anchor many work items in one call

tools.name: mint_rate
tools.description: Rate a completed attestation 1-5; updates the actor's trust score

tools.name: mint_recommend
tools.description: Endorse an actor you've worked with in a named context

tools.name: mint_discover
tools.description: Trust-ranked search of the actor directory by capability

tools.name: mint_verify
tools.description: Verify an attestation / actor's trust profile against the chain

tools.name: mint_trust_score
tools.description: Agent reputation lookup from the trust graph

tools.name: mint_trust_history
tools.description: Full attestation audit trail for an agent

tools.name: mint_trust_compare
tools.description: Rank multiple agents by trust score

tools.name: mint_create_cell
tools.description: Open a stake-backed on-chain work cell (FoundryNet devnet)

tools.name: mint_join_cell
tools.description: Join a work cell by staking; opens participant + trust accounts

tools.name: mint_settle_cell
tools.description: Evaluate + settle a work cell; 96/2/2 split, stakes returned, trust updated

tools.name: mint_create_policy
tools.description: Open a parametric insurance policy with funded coverage escrow

tools.name: mint_settle_policy
tools.description: Settle a policy: pay beneficiary if triggered, else refund insurer
